$comment: Machine-readable mirror of src/styles/globals.css. That file is the source of truth; if the two disagree, the CSS wins.
name: Limbo Mixology

display.source: purchased, self-hosted, not included in this repo

body.source: Google Fonts, self-hosted at build time
body.usage: all body copy, labels, UI text

typography.$note: There is no sans-serif in this product. Both faces are serif, deliberately.

$notes: Palette 3A + the full 13-token dark ramp from the Builder handoff §1.1, 30 Jul 2026.
Set a token against the DARKEST surface it appears on. In dark that is --surface-recessed, not --surface.
Ramp runs surface -> surface-sunk -> surface-recessed. --surface-recessed (#E1DACA light) is the inactive tab fill.
RENAMED 30 Jul: --surface-sunken is now --surface-sunk; --text-secondary is now --text-body.
DELETED 30 Jul: --glyph. Icons take currentColor; a glyph token freezes a call-site mismatch. The one legitimate case, the bin in the line menu, is --danger.
--gold is fills, borders and underlines ONLY, never type, in either mode. --gold-text inverts hardest: #7A5518 has no meaning on dark.
The active tab's top edge is 3px --accent, not 2px --gold: measured 9.27:1 on --surface and 6.95:1 on --surface-recessed, against the 3:1 a sole state indicator needs.
NOT in Design's ramp, left at prior values: bg, surface-alt, border-subtle, accent-hover, accent-fg, accent-surface, accent-surface-fg, danger-bg, warning, warning-bg, warning-border, success.
FAILS AA: dark --accent-fg #F3EEE2 on dark --accent #4A7A6A measures 4.24:1. The alternative #14120E measures 3.82:1. Neither clears 4.5. Open with Design.

radius.$note: Semantic, by component role — so 'make cards less rounded' is one edit and cannot reshape badges by accident.

elevation.$note: Theme-dependent, because light-mode shadows are invisible on a dark background. Restrained — borders do most of the separation work.

spacing.$note: Tailwind 4 default scale. Every padding and gap is a multiple, so the whole layout tightens from one value.

layout.$note: The only breakpoint that matters. An iPad crosses it when rotated — portrait ~820px, landscape ~1180px.

below.header: brand lockup, search icon, settings; slides away on scroll down

atOrAbove.navigation: left sidebar, 240px, collapsible to a 64px icon rail

touch.$note: Non-negotiable. Used standing up with hands full.
touch.minInputFontSizeReason: anything smaller makes iOS Safari zoom on focus
rules: No hover-only interactions, ever. A finger has no hover.
Safe area insets on anything at a screen edge.
Pointer Events, not touch or mouse events — one path covers finger, Apple Pencil, and cursor.
platformLimits: No haptics available in Safari. Gestures must confirm themselves visually.
Apple Pencil hover works on newer iPads but can never be the only route to an action.

antiPatterns: Pure black or neutral grey in dark mode
Grids of large cards for long lists — use rows, for density
